ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location is used to show the route to patients' homes.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: The camera is used to photograph ID cards and to take photos for the AI assistant to look at.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Photos from your library are used as household members' profile pictures and can be sent to the AI assistant to look at.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: Motion sensors make the light on screen shift as you tilt the device.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Used to connect to a development computer on the same network to load code during development.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Speech recognition turns what you say into text — in the notebook, in search and when talking to the AI assistant — processed on this device.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: The microphone listens to what you say, for dictating notes, voice search and talking to the AI assistant.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Face ID unlocks Atlas HomeCare instead of entering your PIN.
